metadata.name: minimal_direction_g2_certificate
metadata.description: Aggregate certificate for the minimal exceptional direction (R,H)=(6,5), g=2, equivalently (r,h)=(12,10).

-11.conclusion: Every admissible residue class modulo 22 is separated modulo 5.

-9.conclusion: Every admissible k is separated modulo 5, except k == 0 or 13 mod 31; those two classes are separated modulo 23.

-7.conclusion: Every admissible k is separated modulo 37, except the listed classes, which are separated modulo 5.

-5.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 37, except survivor classes; all survivor lifts modulo 756 are separated modulo 23.

-3.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 37; except survivor classes. Mod 5 separates all but two survivor classes. All lifts of those two classes modulo 900 are separated modulo 23.

-1.admissibility: k >= 1 and k != 0 mod 23 and k != 9 mod 11
-1.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 47, except survivor classes. Mod 5 separates all survivor classes.

1.admissibility: k >= 0 and k != 2 mod 7 and k != 2 mod 13
1.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 37, except survivor classes. Mod 23 separates both lifts of all survivor classes.

3.admissibility: k >= 0 and k != 12 mod 19 and k != 4 mod 5
3.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 47, except eight classes. Mod 5 separates six of those. Mod 23 separates the remaining two.

survivor_paths.P_path: L R^N L R L R^4

5.conclusion: mod 37 handles k !=15 mod17; symbolic positivity handles k=17n+15. Hence c=5 is excluded.

7.admissibility: k >= 0 and k != 2 mod 5 and k != 3 mod 19
7.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 47, except eight classes. Mod 5 separates six of those. Mod 23 separates the remaining two.

9.admissibility: k >= 0 and k != 7 mod 13 and k != 1 mod 7
9.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 37 except the survivor classes; modulo 23 separates both lifts of all survivors.

11.admissibility: k >= 0 and k != 9 mod 11 and k != 19 mod 23
11.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 47, except survivor classes. Mod 5 separates all survivor classes.

13.conclusion: Every admissible class is separated modulo 37, except survivor classes. Mod 5 separates all but two survivor classes. All lifts of those two classes modulo 900 are separated modulo 23.

15.conclusion: Every admissible k is separated modulo 37, except the listed classes, whose lifts modulo 756 are separated modulo 23.

17.conclusion: Every admissible k is separated modulo 37, except the listed classes, which are separated modulo 5.

19.conclusion: Every admissible k is separated modulo 5, except k == 14 or 27 mod 31; those two classes are separated modulo 23.

21.conclusion: Every admissible residue class modulo 132 is separated modulo 5.
